# Trading Direkt 2026-10-30 | Tech-journalisten Scholader om AI, Big Tech och halvledare, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-10-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on the US tech reporting week, where guest Alice Schölander of Nyhetsbyrån Direkt argues that worries have shifted to heavy AI capex, debt and unprofitable end products, with Alphabet's 12.6% drop reflecting concern about its ad business model. She favours ASML, TSMC and Munters long term and advises waiting on Alphabet, and is cautious on property, especially office landlords. Technical analyst Tobbe Rosén is constructive on OMXS30, DAX and S&P 500 into year-end despite overbought short-term readings, while the market update shows AI-related selling in the US and Asia alongside strong reports from AstraZeneca and Loomis.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest answers no to buying the dip; a short-term bounce is possible, she would wait medium term, positive long term.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Alphabet fell 12.6% after an EPS miss and negative free cash flow. She sees the concern as business-model driven, with AI search generating less ad revenue, while Cloud grows over 100%. She expects a small short-term upward correction and is not worried long term, but would wait to see how strategy develops.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI search keeps eroding ad revenue without a new monetisation model
- if users shift to competing language models

> *"Men medelfristigt tror jag ändå att jag hade nog avvaktat lite faktiskt."*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's Swedish pick to be stronger over three years; entrenched data centre cooling position, competing mainly with Vertiv.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Munters is a 'picks and shovels' AI play because large data centres need climate control. She says it should not be underestimated, describes it and Vertiv as the two big players, and agrees it is the Swedish case likely to be stronger over the next three years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI data centre buildout slows
- if Vertiv takes share in data centre cooling

> *"Jag tycker inte att man ska underskatta Munters, klimatkontrollbolaget som kyler kyler datacenter"*

---

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's European favourite over three years; lithography leader with practically no competitors and high entry barriers.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. ASML is called an unavoidable part of the chip supply chain, more or less without competitors. Its position rests on advanced technology built over many years and high barriers in competence and capital. She names it as her European pick to be stronger over three years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credible lithography competitors emerge
- if AI infrastructure investment falls away

> *"Nej, men det blir ASML. De är kända och stora, men det finns en anledning till att de är det."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's most interesting AI company outside the US and her pick as biggest AI winner to 2030.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. TSMC is called a very necessary part of the chip supply chain and is her answer on both the most interesting non-US AI company and the largest AI winner through 2030. She notes new Taiwanese competitors are appearing but says that takes time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new competitors gain meaningful share
- if the AI end product fails to become profitable

> *"Största vinnaren på AI fram till 2030? Även där kommer jag svara att ISMC tror jag."*

---

### 🟠 AVGO — Broadcom | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest's most underrated semiconductor stock after some decline; won share from Nvidia and has a networking offering.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion from a quick-fire round. She calls Broadcom the most underrated semiconductor stock, noting that it has fallen somewhat, won some share from Nvidia and sells networking solutions beyond chips. No explicit buy call was given, so this is treated as a watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if share gains against Nvidia reverse

> *"Mest underskattade halvledaraktien? Broadcom skulle jag säga då."*

---

### 🟠 SYSR — Systemair | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Bollinger squeeze and triangle pattern; Rosén expects price expansion but direction is undecided, wait for a break.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Band width is the lowest in at least six months, with a triangle-like formation. Rosén says a break of either level should trigger expansion, and advises waiting for it, or scaling in small with a tight stop on a continuation pattern at rising support.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rising support line breaks downward

> *"Den av de här nivåerna som tas ut eller punkteras tror jag kommer leda till en prisexpansion som kan vara intressant."*

---

### 🟠 TIETOS — Tieto | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Stretched-rubber-band setup at MA200 after negative report reaction; RSI2 under 5, already up 1.8%.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. The stock fell to the 200-day average after a negative report reaction, with RSI2 under 5 and a tendency to positive divergence. Rosén says it is reacting as planned but wants a counter-reaction at support before acting, and has already moved 1.8%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MA200 support fails

> *"Och det ser som sagt ut som att aktien reagerar enligt plan nu."*

---

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Triangle breakout, MA200 icebreak to multi-month high close, plus Q3 core EPS and revenue beat; shares up about 3%.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view supported by the market update. A long triangle base gave a breakout, which was retested, followed by an MA200 icebreak above several months of closing highs. Rosén calls this a very positive signal but notes the market has partly acted already. Q3 beat expectations and 2026 guidance was repeated.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price falls back below the former resistance zone

> *"Så det är en väldigt positiv signal och det har som sagt placerarkollektivet redan agerat på till viss del ser jag."*

---

### 🟢 SCST — Scandi Standard | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Medium-term momentum screen: strong three-month gain, neither parabolic nor faltering, 'strength breeds strength'.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Scandi Standard appeared in Rosén's medium-term screen, sitting in the upper right corner of a three-month chart after a steady advance. He sees fairly good conditions for it to continue higher.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the steady uptrend breaks down

> *"Så jag ser det som ganska goda förutsättningar att Scandi Standard kan fortsätta."*

---

### ⛔ AAK — AAK | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Falling tops after negatively received report; bounces treated as pauses in the decline until price and lagging line clear the cloud.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Ichimoku analysis shows a pattern of falling tops, raising the risk of further decline. Rosén wants price to turn up, take out the standard line and latest top, clear Cloud Span B, and have both price and lagging line above the cloud before turning positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price clears latest top and both price and lagging line get above the cloud

> *"så är uppstudsar att betrakta som paus formationer i nedgången."*

---

### ⛔ ALLEI — Alleima | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Very negative report reaction and exceptionally high vol; Rosén negative, warns of catching a falling knife.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. After the report, the lagging line ran into price and a break under the cloud risked selling pressure. Rosén says he is negative but sees possible entry levels once volatility contracts from its extreme and positive candlestick formations appear near support.

#### Sell Triggers

- if volatility contracts and positive candlestick patterns form at support

> *"Så jag är negativ till Aleima."*

---

### 🟠 ARM — ARM Holdings | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Testing MA200 below the cloud; momentum nearing a positive cross. Neutral with a slightly negative undertone.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. The lagging line is below price and price is below the cloud, indicating a risk of further decline, though negative momentum has eased. Rosén advises waiting, and wants price above the cloud and the lagging line above price before turning positive again.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MA200 breaks with continued weak momentum

> *"Jag är neutral för tillfället med lite svagt negativ underton tycker jag."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lower significant tops, price under cloud; must clear about 2.88-2.89 and the cloud before view changes.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Intrum shows lower tops all the way down, with lagging line under price, price under the cloud and a cloud indicating further decline. Volatility is fairly high, so contraction could mark a bottom, but Rosén first wants the latest short-term top and the cloud cleared.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price clears about 2.88-2.89 and breaks above the cloud with the lagging line

> *"Så än så länge så är jag negativ och ser uppstudsar som paus formationer i nedgången."*

---

### 🟢 MILDEF — Mildef | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Above rising MA200, pullbacks bounce at the cloud; Rosén clearly positive and calls pullbacks buyable despite the report.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Price is above a rising MA200, pullbacks hold in the cloud zone, the forward cloud rises, and trend indicators favour trend-following. Volume balance is neutral. Volatility is near or heading above average, so he prefers pullbacks and continuation patterns over buying breakouts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the current chart structure breaks down
- if price loses the cloud zone and rising MA200

> *"Så jag är tydligt positiv till Mildef även om rapportrevisionen kanske inte var så bra."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lagging line above price, price above cloud, turning line above standard, positive cloud cross; Rosén expects further gains.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. All Ichimoku components are aligned positively, volume balance is slightly positive, and a positive cloud cross suggests price is more likely to rise than fall going forward. Rosén finds it interesting and believes in continued gains.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price falls under the cloud

> *"Saab är också positiv till och tror på fortsatta uppgångar."*

---

### 🟠 SEYE — Smart Eye | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Rosén still negative with price under cloud, but lagging line reaching price and wide cloud may precede a turn.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Price is below the cloud and the stated view stays negative. However, the lagging line running into price after a decline can mean a slower decline, contraction or trend shift, and a similar setup earlier preceded a rise. Narrowing of Cloud Span A would be worth monitoring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if decline continues without lagging line crossing above price

> *"Dock så är fortfarande negativ till aktien."*

---

### ⛔ 8TRA — Traton | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Declining since its top, weak report reaction, negative volume balance; slight positive divergence but Rosén slightly negative.

#### Reasoning

Technical analyst view. Price has continued lower since the lagging line ran into price, and the report reaction was unconvincing. Volume balance is negative and the trend indicator points to more downside risk. Rosén wants a positive candlestick, the latest top cleared, and price and lagging line above the cloud.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price takes out latest top and clears the cloud with the lagging line

> *"Så lite negativ även till traton."*

---

### 🟡 BOL — Boliden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst: DNB Carnegie cut to hold from buy, target 550 from 580 kr; shares about 495 kr.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion, not the hosts' view. DNB Carnegie lowered its recommendation to hold from buy and cut its price target by 5% to 550 kr. The shares fell 2.7% to about 495 kr. No rationale for the cut was given in the episode.

> *"DNB Carnegie har sänkt rekommendationen för Boliden till behåll från köp."*

---

### 🟡 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst: Handelsbanken cut to hold from buy, target 64 from 93 kr; shares around 58 kr, down 6.3%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion, not the hosts' view. Handelsbanken lowered its recommendation to hold from buy and cut its target sharply from 93 to 64 kr. The name was transcribed as 'Encon' and is resolved to Engcon. No rationale was given in the episode.

> *"Handelsbanken har sänkt rekommendationen för Encon till behåll från köp och riktkursen sänks från 93 till 64 kronor."*
